**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

- **Investigated:** § 12.3 (planner hint), § 7.1 and § 8.3 (pricing), plus targeted searches for MFN/most-favoured/no-less-favourable, matching, benchmarking, and best-pricing mechanics across the full document, and a review of the complete section outline.
- **Result:** No provision requires Meridian to extend Copperleaf terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, or to match/disclose third-party offers. § 12.3 expressly records that Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment; § 7.1 fixes Fees and § 8.3 caps renewal increases, both of which run in our favour.
- **Not double-flagged:** the § 2.2 exclusivity and § 12.4 non-compete are separate commercial terms handled under the exclusivity/non-compete rules, not MFN.
- No redline proposed, as required for compliant findings.
